description:
Bundles five substrate updates surfaced empirically during ariadne--m20 (closed 2026-05-04 at a161630). Two parts:

PART A — POLYBIUS-pair coordination protocol
- stoa--ivc — radio-check pattern (peer-failure detection, heartbeats, missed-check escalation, closure handshake)
- stoa--ay1 — adaptive polling cadence (active */2 / default */5 / quiet */15)
- stoa--blg — explicit cross-tier write boundaries (read AND write asymmetry, downward-only)

Lands in: substrate/operating-disciplines.md (new §7 coordination section), substrate/MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md §7.1 (write rules) + §7.4 (cross-ref), substrate/templates/polling-cron-prompt-template.md (new).

PART B — Downstream-handoff discipline
- stoa--xh2 — activation paste-filename divergence (project unsuffixed vs subproject suffixed); install.sh next-steps + cheatsheet
- stoa--m5m — positive-references-only when authoring paste-instructions for downstream agents

Lands in: substrate/MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md §5.1 + new §5.5, substrate/templates/activation-paste-cheatsheet.md (new), substrate/install.sh next-steps block, substrate/operating-disciplines.md §8 (positive-references universal).

Directive: substrate/arcs/arc-21-build-directive.md (POLYBIUS authors + commits before dispatch).

Multi-concern → §5.4 external review (CAPTAIN_ARGUS cold-audit) before dispatching MAJOR_PLINY.

Empirical anchors come from ariadne--m20 thread — radio-check protocol was demonstrated live (initialization handshake + heartbeats + closure), cadence churn was felt during active sections, write-boundaries violation was caught by PRINCIPAL real-time, the the-stoa install paste failure was the original surfacing moment for stoa--xh2, and 'NOT user-beadwork' negative seeding triggered stoa--m5m.
